your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: $363, dark-blue monopoly live but unbuilt. One house ($200) only lifts BW to $200 and leaves $163 — misses St James ($180) and is thin for Virginia ($160). 3-house kill line still needs ~$600; don't mortgage blockers just to get a weak house. No +EV trade: Kentucky/St Charles/Vermont/WW are blocks, not sale pieces. Reds 3-way split; oranges/pinks/LB/greens all 1-1 with the third unowned. Next roll from Vermont most likely hits Virginia, States, my RR, or St James — keep cash to buy the swing lots. Reassess build after this stretch.

Reject. $260 is only $40 over list and hands p3 Kentucky+Illinois, a clear 2/3 red path toward Indiana. Blocking value is far higher; don't name a price. $363 still covers a swing buy. Dark blue stays unbuilt until cash can reach a real house line without selling blockers.

Cash $363, dark blue live but unbuilt. One house ($200) only bumps BW to $200 and blocks St James ($180), Virginia ($160), Reading ($200), and Atlantic ($260). 3-house line still needs $600 and does not bankrupt anyone (poorest is p1 at $784); kill line is 5 houses/$1000 (3 BW + 2 PP) which I cannot fund without a dangerous sale and a cash cushion. p3 (~31%) and p4 (~19%) may hit unowned yellows next roll — I cannot stop that; keep liquidity to contest yellows and other swing lots. Do not sell Kentucky (red block; third piece is owned, but still the key chip), St Charles or Vermont (thirds unowned), or WW (completes p4 utilities). No +EV trade. Reassess build only above ~$800 so 3 houses leave a tax buffer.

Counter, not accept. Their $100+Oriental is worse than the $260 I already rejected and does not fund a kill. $450+Oriental leaves me $853 cash; mortgage St Charles/Vermont/Penn RR/WW/Oriental (~$345) to reach ~$1198, then build evenly 3 BW + 2 PP ($1000). Buffer ~$198. BW at 3 houses is $1400, which bankrupts p1 (~$1224 liquid) and p4 (~$1320) and a cash-light p3. Must build evenly. Do not signal the build. If they won't pay ~$450 equivalent, reject — 2+2 houses ($600/$500 rents) do not kill and Kentucky's red block is worth more. Red completion still needs Indiana from p1, who refuses cash, so the window is mine if this closes.

Reject-level offer. $180+Oriental leaves $583; even mortgaging VT/SC/RR/WW/Oriental (+$345=$928) cannot fund 5 dark-blue houses ($1000). 2+2 houses ($600/$500) kills nobody (liquids: p1 ~$1224, p4 ~$1320, p3 ~$883 after this deal) and hands p3 2/3 reds. Hold near $450. Counter $400+Oriental: cash $803+$345=$1148, build 3 BW+2 PP, buffer ~$148. BW $1400 bankrupts all three even after they mortgage. Income tax is a full lap away; GO restores buffer first. Chairman card ($150) is the only thin spot. Do not telegraph the build. If they stay under ~$350, reject and keep the red block.

Do not accept $230. Cash is $403. $230+Oriental → $633; mortgage VT/SC/RR/WW/Oriental ($345) = $978, $22 short of 5 dark-blue houses ($1000). 2+2 ($800, rents $500/$600) kills nobody and hands p3 2/3 reds. Floor stays $400: fund $403+$400+$345=$1148, build 3 BW+2 PP, buffer ~$148 (chairman $150 is the thin spot; repairs $200 is not covered). Below ~$380, reject and keep the red block. Do not telegraph the build. p1 still refuses to sell Indiana, so reds aren't completable yet — the window is mine only if this price lands.

Don't pay $200. Dark blue is the win condition; $200 is a house, not a second railroad. 2 RRs only pay $50 and I can never complete the set (p1 has B&O). Keep $603: build 2 houses ($400) and hold ~$203 for Virginia/St James, or push 3 houses if the board looks safe. Auction drains whoever wins. Bid only if it goes well under $120; otherwise let them spend.
Drop. $185+ is a house, not a railroad. 2 RRs only pay $50 and the set is blocked (p1 has B&O). Keep $603 for dark-blue houses: 2 houses ($400) leaves ~$203 for Virginia/St James. Let p1 drain cash.

Mortgaged Penn RR, cash now $703. Continue the plan: mortgage WW ($75), St Charles ($70), Vermont ($50) to reach $898, then build 2 houses on Boardwalk and 2 on Park Place ($800), leaving ~$98. Keep Kentucky unmortgaged as the $110 emergency backstop. Do not touch the kill-line 3+2 build. Next action: mortgage Water Works.

Cash $403, BW1/PP0, nothing mortgaged. Dark blue is the win; 3+2 kill ($800) needs every mortgage and leaves ~$8 — fatal on the next rent. Target BW2/PP2 ($600): mortgage RR $100, WW $75, St Charles $70, Vermont $50 → $698, build 3 houses, leave ~$98. Keep Kentucky unmortgaged ($110 backstop; still blocks p3's reds). Do not trade Kentucky under ~$400. Next: mortgage Water Works.
